title: typescript / TypeScript extensions
content:
## TypeScript extensions {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} provides many features for TypeScript out of the box. In addition to what comes built-in, you can install an extension for greater functionality.
> Tip: Click on an extension tile above to read the description and reviews to decide which extension is best for you. See more in the [Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com).
